root: Uni-CLI 0.224.0 is the architecture and dependency refresh release for the agent-to-software bridge.
`unicli architecture audit` exposes a callable command/tree surface for catalog, runtime, and evidence-layer inspection.
`unicli search` now stays backed by the live registry and caches by registry version, removing the stale generated search-index path.
Local computer-use action results now include overlay/evidence metadata so agents can close the observe-act-verify loop more directly.
The runtime floor is Node.js 22.19+ to support `undici@8`; `undici`, `ws`, `zod`, and transitive `fast-uri` are refreshed to current secure registry resolutions.
CI and branch-protection documentation now match the Node 22 release matrix and current sidecar gates.
zh: Uni-CLI 0.224.0 是面向 agent-to-software bridge 的架构与依赖刷新版本。
`unicli architecture audit` 暴露可调用的命令/树状视图，用来检查目录、运行时和 evidence layer。
`unicli search` 现在直接基于 live registry，并按 registry version 缓存，删除旧的 generated search-index 路径。
Local computer-use action 结果现在带 overlay/evidence metadata，Agent 可以更直接地闭合 observe-act-verify loop。
运行时下限提升到 Node.js 22.19+ 以支持 `undici@8`；`undici`、`ws`、`zod` 和 transitive `fast-uri` 都刷新到当前安全解析版本。
CI 和 branch-protection 文档现在与 Node 22 发布矩阵及当前 sidecar gates 对齐。
